actions: Established the causal graph is a derived cache: update_causal_graph.py ships --rebuild which reconstructs it from the 278 committed episode files
Established no runtime reader consumes it; the only referents are its own maintenance scripts, a re-export, and the lefthook writer job
Established its output is noise: 6 patterns after 277 sessions, two of them literal test fixtures, three with trigger identical to action
Established the justifying eval is circular: it measures recall of the memory skill's own documentation, not an engineering outcome
Established the Tier 2 boundary is real: episodes are read by rework_warning.py and by CI validate_investigation_claims.py, neither of which maintains episodes
Removed .agents/memory/causality/causal-graph.json, the 1.05 MB single-file blob responsible for the repository's worst merge conflicts
Removed the graph writer, the provenance backfiller, the id repair script, the JSON schema, and their tests across the .claude canonical tree and the src/copilot-cli mirror
Removed the custom merge driver, its installer, and the merge=causal-graph attribute; install_merge_drivers.py registered only this one driver so the whole script went
Removed the update-causal-graph and install-merge-drivers lefthook jobs
Updated the memory skill surfaces to drop Tier 3 while leaving Tier 2 episodic memory intact
Filed an ADR superseding the Tier 3 portion of ADR-038, left at proposed status pending an adr-review debate log
Ran the adr-review 6-agent debate on ADR-088; 4 of 6 blocked the first round
Corrected five refuted claims in ADR-088, including two the ADR used to justify itself, and removed a fabricated consumer table from memory-reflexion
Added tests/test_causal_tier_removed.py, 21 inverse tests, negative-controlled by reintroducing the graph, the merge attribute, and the lefthook job
Filed issues 3630 and 3631 for the two findings that outlive this change
Wrote the debate log and the retrospective

nextSteps: Latent defects left in place and recorded on issue #3502: the merge=ours attribute names a driver git does not provide, merge=handoff-aggregate is declared but unimplemented, and get_pr_checks.py reports AllPassing true when the merge ref cannot be built
